name: roblox-doc-search
title: Roblox Doc Search
description: Quickly search through the Roblox API documentation and find the information you need without leaving your current workflow.
author: everdaletop

preferences.name: showDeprecated
preferences.label: Show Deprecated
preferences.description: Show deprecated items in search results

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
